M2.L1.title: Explore time as a continuous measurement using a stopwatch.

M2.L2.title: Solve word problems involving time intervals within 1 hour by counting backward and forward using the number line and clock.

M2.L3.title: Solve word problems involving time intervals within 1 hour by adding and subtracting on the number line.

M2.L4.title: Build and decompose a kilogram to reason about the size and weight of 1 kilogram, 100 grams, 10 grams, and 1 gram.

M2.L5.title: Develop estimation strategies by reasoning about the weight in kilograms of a series of familiar objects to establish mental benchmark measures.

M2.L6.title: Solve one-step word problems involving metric weights within

M2.L7.title: Decompose a liter to reason about the size of 1 liter, 100 milliliters, 10 milliliters, and 1 milliliter.

M2.L8.title: Estimate and measure liquid volume in liters and milliliters using the vertical number line.

M2.L9.title: Solve mixed word problems involving all four operations with grams, kilograms, liters, and milliliters given in the same units.

M2.L10.title: Name numbers up to 100,000 by building understanding of the place value chart and placement of commas for naming base thousand units.

M2.L11.title: Read and write numbers to 100,000 using base ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and expanded notation.

M2.L12.title: Compare numbers based on the meaning of the digits using <, >, or = to record the comparison.

M2.L13.title: Round two-digit measurements to the nearest ten on the vertical number line.

M2.L14.title: Round two- and three-digit numbers to the nearest ten on the vertical number line.

M2.L15.title: Round to the nearest hundred on the vertical number line.

M2.L16.title: Round four- and five-digit numbers using the vertical number line.

M2.L17.title: Add measurements using the standard algorithm to compose larger units once.

M2.L18.title: Add measurements using the standard algorithm to compose larger units twice.

M2.L19.title: Estimate sums by rounding and apply to solve measurement word problems.

M2.L20.title: Decompose once to subtract measurements including three- digit minuends with zeros in the tens or ones place.

M2.L21.title: Decompose twice to subtract measurements including three- digit minuends with zeros in the tens and ones places.

M2.L22.title: Estimate differences by rounding and apply to solve measurement word problems.

M2.L23.title: Estimate sums and differences of measurements by rounding, and then solve mixed word problems.
